summary: Created a new draft via the Library "New Draft" button (draft left named "Untitled"). On the Script tab I wrote a two-scene script introducing Brew: Scene 1 — "Meet Brew, the coffee ordering app that gets your morning right. Open Brew and your favorite cafe is one tap away." and Scene 2 (created with the timeline's Add scene control) — "Pick your size, milk, and pickup time, pay in the app, and Brew tells you the moment your coffee is ready." Both scenes appear as separate scene blocks in the script pane and timeline. Then I opened the voice picker and selected Cassidy; the control now reads "Select voice: Cassidy". Nothing was published, exported, or recorded, and the draft was not renamed.
